A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.
The registration flow: what personal details the form collects.
The risk disclosure: where the capital-at-risk wording sits.
The security claims: encryption and account protection statements.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Create the account with your contact details, then verify it through the emailed link.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Fund the account with US$250 - bank cards, transfer, PayPal and Skrill are accepted.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Choose the risk settings and execution mode, then start with the practice balance.

pros: Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
redFlags: Template placeholders left unrendered.
Return claims without verification.
The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: For a cautious newcomer, ilmainen konsultaation can work: start on the demo, deposit the US$250 minimum and keep your own numbers.
Our 4.7 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
